tailoring.headline: Consultant E-Commerce | SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Specialist
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Consultant and SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building and integrating large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, microservices, PIM/ERP/MDM integration, and database optimization. Proven ability to bridge business requirements and technical execution, translating complex stakeholder needs into robust e-commerce solutions within agile international environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Consultant E-Commerce (w/m/d)
cover_en.hook: Bechtle Network & Security Solutions GmbH delivers exceptional IT and e-commerce architectures, making your consulting practice an ideal environment for my expertise. Over the past 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have specialized in delivering complex SAP Commerce Cloud solutions that align technical depth with business strategy.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Consulting & Requirements
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role bridging business stakeholders and IT, analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and translating them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & API Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, exposing OCC REST Web Services for headless commerce channels.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Stakeholders
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with international technical and business teams across multiple release cycles, supporting UAT, code reviews and continuous deployment workflows.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my consulting and development expertise can contribute to Bechtle.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Consultant E-Commerce (w/m/d)
cover_de.hook: Die Bechtle Network & Security Solutions GmbH steht für erstklassige IT- und E-Commerce-Lösungen, weshalb ich mich mit großer Begeisterung auf diese Position bewerbe. In den vergangenen 5+ Jahren habe ich bei Rockwell Automation und Shell umfassende Expertise in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer SAP Commerce Cloud-Projekte aufgebaut.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Beratung & Analyse
bullets.text: In einer techno-funktionalen Rolle habe ich eng mit Business-Stakeholdern zusammengearbeitet, Anforderungen analysiert, User Stories sowie funktionale Spezifikationen erstellt und in SAP Commerce-Lösungen übersetzt.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwicklung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring sowie Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services für Headless-Architekturen.

bullets.label: Systemintegrationen
bullets.text: Konzeption und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mittels Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub sowie Klärung von Integrationsfragen zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und E-Commerce-Kanälen.

bullets.label: Agile Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Erfolgreiche Mitarbeit in internationalen Scrum-Teams, Begleitung von UAT-Phasen, Durchführung von Code Reviews und Unterstützung des operativen Betriebs.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine unbeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer ordentlichen Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026 (frühester Eintritt: 16.12.2026). Gerne überzeuge ich Sie in einem persönlichen Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: Bechtle combines strong system house capabilities with customer-centric e-commerce solutions, creating an inspiring environment for techno-functional consultants. I want to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise to help your clients bridge business strategy and technical execution effectively.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise and techno-functional consulting background to drive impactful e-commerce projects at Bechtle.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years as an SAP Commerce Developer and techno-functional consultant at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Consultant E-Commerce role at Bechtle. I bring strong Java, Spring, and integration experience. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the Consultant E-Commerce position at Bechtle Network & Security Solutions GmbH. With over 5 years of experience building and integrating enterprise SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and techno-functional consulting.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
